entries.acceptance: Use perception plus the acute-sense modifier appropriate to the actual sense; special senses retain their own capabilities and restrictions.
Noticing an event is distinct from understanding it; an authored follow-up uses intelligence for ordinary interpretation or the relevant specialist skill.
After failing to notice or understand a dangerous event, a qualifying danger-warning trait permits a secret perception roll; success discloses the warning rather than fabricated full knowledge.
Vision includes applicable acute bonus, +3 broad-spectrum sight, size/range effects and partial-darkness penalties from -1 through -9.
Total darkness prevents ordinary sight without an appropriate trait or aid; low-light vision cancels one partial-darkness penalty per level and dark sight ignores darkness.
Plainly visible objects may grant +10; hidden-object searches, reading and face identification do not automatically get that bonus.
An authored hidden-object task may contest vision or required observation/search against the relevant concealment skill.
Planetary curvature can block visibility; author observer elevation and world geometry rather than using a fixed three-mile limit everywhere. Space has no planetary horizon by default.
Apply the actual visual arc, including peripheral, all-around and restricted vision, to tactical facing before offering a roll.
Telescopic vision cancels one range penalty per level; nearsightedness penalizes spotting beyond one yard by six and farsightedness penalizes within one yard by six.
Blindness prevents ordinary visual detection; a substitute sense does not become vision implicitly.
Hearing includes the acute bonus, +4 discriminating hearing and -4 poor hearing, with authored ambient-noise and source-loudness adjustments.
Each doubling step beyond a sound's listed zero-penalty range imposes -1 and each nearer step grants +1; ordinary conversation at eight yards is -3.
Listening for deliberate quiet movement may contest perception against stealth; active listening can use observation when authorized.
Directional amplification and subsonic/ultrasonic senses alter available signals according to their traits; deafness prevents ordinary hearing.
Hearing speech does not ensure comprehension; resolve an appropriate intelligence and language-dependent interpretation when required.
Taste and smell share their acute-sense trait, with +4 from the applicable discriminating sense; author intensity and disguise adjustments separately.
Discriminating taste or smell can identify detailed people, places or objects according to evidence; no taste/smell prevents both forms of ordinary detection.
The rustling sound category has zero range penalty at 0.25 yards; apply doubling-step hearing modifiers around that reference distance.
The quiet-speech sound category has zero range penalty at 0.5 yards; apply doubling-step hearing modifiers around that reference distance.
The ordinary-speech sound category has zero range penalty at 1 yards; apply doubling-step hearing modifiers around that reference distance.
The light-traffic sound category has zero range penalty at 2 yards; apply doubling-step hearing modifiers around that reference distance.
The loud-speech sound category has zero range penalty at 4 yards; apply doubling-step hearing modifiers around that reference distance.
The busy-office sound category has zero range penalty at 8 yards; apply doubling-step hearing modifiers around that reference distance.
The ordinary-traffic sound category has zero range penalty at 16 yards; apply doubling-step hearing modifiers around that reference distance.
The moderate-amplified-music sound category has zero range penalty at 32 yards; apply doubling-step hearing modifiers around that reference distance.
The heavy-traffic sound category has zero range penalty at 64 yards; apply doubling-step hearing modifiers around that reference distance.
The jet-departure sound category has zero range penalty at 128 yards; apply doubling-step hearing modifiers around that reference distance.
The very-loud-amplified-music sound category has zero range penalty at 256 yards; apply doubling-step hearing modifiers around that reference distance.
The extreme-amplified-sound sound category has zero range penalty at 512 yards; apply doubling-step hearing modifiers around that reference distance.
For an eligible situation an actor may substitute a selected influence skill for an ordinary reaction roll; author suitability and any specially permitted alternative skill.
Resolve influence as skill against subject will in a quick contest, including applicable personal reaction and skill-specific modifiers.
An inappropriate influence approach carries an authored -1 through -10 penalty; do not silently substitute a more suitable skill.
Winning yields a good reaction, or very good for attraction-based influence; preserve reaction categories for downstream requests.
A nonwinning result gives a bad reaction, or very bad for specious intimidation; ties do not count as wins.
Diplomacy also obtains an ordinary reaction roll and keeps the better outcome, consuming that extra roll only for this procedure.
An unyielding subject defeats influence automatically unless the actor has the appropriate type of empathy.
Intimidation automatically fails against an unflappable subject.
A subject with dependent initiative automatically loses to influence, without a contest roll; conflicting automatic cases need explicit source-backed precedence.
Propaganda for media or psychology for other psychological operations uses the cause's reaction modifiers and the target group's average will.
Against a player character, a successful influence result supplies its victory margin as a contextual roll modifier rather than dictating the player's chosen attitude or actions.
The author identifies affected dealings, checks, sign and duration of the influence modifier; scope it to the influencing actor and do not apply it globally.
Choose will or a disadvantage's self-control roll from the cause of stress, not from which target is easier or the similarity of the resulting condition.
A modifier specifically resisting an effect normally applies to both will and self-control checks against that effect; retain the original check type.
A successful will check against stress or distraction permits normal action; failed effects require a task-specific authored consequence.
An authored fear event identifies why it is extraordinary for this actor, with background and setting considered; ordinary threatening events need not trigger fear checks.
An unflappable actor does not make fear checks; do not consume random dice before deciding immunity.
